import json,csv,glob,re,statistics,collections
sol=json.load(open('/app/output/solution.json'))
logs={r['record_id']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open('/app/data/test_center_logs.csv',encoding='utf-8-sig'))}
books={}; code={}
for p in glob.glob('/app/data/codebook_*.csv'):
 for r in csv.DictReader(open(p,encoding='utf-8-sig')):
  code[(r['product_id'],r['code'])]=r
assert len(sol['records'])==len(logs)==12000
assert len({r['record_id'] for r in sol['records']})==12000
known=[]; unknown=[]; errors=[]; scopes=[]; overlaps=[]; cats=collections.Counter(); prods=collections.defaultdict(lambda:[0,0])
def toks(x): return set(re.findall(r'[a-z0-9_]+|[\u4e00-\u9fff]+',x.lower()))
for r in sol['records']:
 src=logs[r['record_id']]
 for k in ['product_id','station','engineer_id','raw_reason_text']: assert r[k]==src[k]
 assert r['normalized']
 for i,s in enumerate(r['normalized'],1):
  assert s['segment_id']==f"{r['record_id']}-S{i}"
  assert s['span_text'] and s['span_text'] in r['raw_reason_text']
  assert 0<=s['confidence']<=1
  prods[r['product_id']][1]+=1
  if s['pred_code']=='UNKNOWN':
   assert s['pred_label']=='';unknown.append(s['confidence']);prods[r['product_id']][0]+=1
  else:
   b=code[(r['product_id'],s['pred_code'])];assert s['pred_label']==b['standard_label'];known.append(s['confidence']);cats[b['category_lv2']]+=1
   scopes.append(r['station'] in b['station_scope'].split(';'))
   kt=toks(' '.join([b['standard_label'],b['keywords_examples'],b['category_lv1'],b['category_lv2']]))
   st=toks(s['span_text']);overlaps.append(len(st&kt)/len(st|kt) if st and kt else 0)
print('records',len(sol['records']),'segments',len(known)+len(unknown),'known',len(known),'unknown',len(unknown),'unknown_rate',round(len(unknown)/(len(known)+len(unknown)),3))
print('by_product_unknown', {p:round(u/t,3) for p,(u,t) in prods.items()})
print('conf known',min(known),statistics.mean(known),max(known),'unknown',min(unknown),statistics.mean(unknown),max(unknown),'separated',max(unknown)<min(known))
print('scope',sum(scopes)/len(scopes))
print('overlap mean',statistics.mean(overlaps),'p60',sorted(overlaps)[int(.6*(len(overlaps)-1))],'>=.01',sum(x>=.01 for x in overlaps)/len(overlaps))
print('known categories',cats)
